Agent Name: Engineer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Engineer made a critical logic error in the implementation of the Cocktail Shaker Sort algorithm. Specifically, in the backward pass loop, the condition `if arr[i] < arr[i - 1]` is incorrect. The correct condition should be `if arr[i] > arr[i - 1]` because we want to swap elements when the current element is greater than the previous one (to move larger elements to the right). The Engineer's condition `arr[i] < arr[i - 1]` would only swap when the current element is smaller than the previous one, which is the opposite of what's needed for sorting in ascending order. This error causes the algorithm to sort the array in descending order instead of ascending order, failing the test cases provided in the problem statement.
